Join now: https://www.theroundup.so/ In this video we go through everything we actually use to stretch our claude code usage limits and get more work done on the same plan, across both Claude Code and Codex. items.title: BMAD's Founder on the Future of AI Coding (And the Slop Apocalypse)
items.summary: There's a slop apocalypse coming, and it's not broken AI generated code crashing everything in production. It's the quiet kind: comments drift out of sync with what the code actually does, nobody goes back and refactors what the agent wrote, and over time that's what makes the coding agent slower and more expensive to work with (the real failure mode). That's Brian Madison's read on where AI coding is headed, and a couple days ago I sat down with him to dig into it - why "human on the loop" beats full automation, what's coming in BMAD v7, and how his framework and my own landed on almost the same philosophy independently. items.title: Your AI Second Brain Is Slowly Rotting (Here's How to Fix It)
items.summary: Granola is the AI notepad for professionals in back-to-back meetings: https://www.granola.ai?via=cole-medin Every guide to building an AI second brain goes over the same components and stops before covering how to actually maintain your second brain and stop it from drifting over time. I have been running my second brain for six months now. My memory folder is 1.9 million words! What reaches the agent every session is about 10,000. Compressing it was never the hard part - keeping those 10,000 words TRUE is. So in this video, I cover how your second brain is probably rotting right now and the solution so you can keep your second brain sharp! We want our second brains to get smarter over time, and this is a huge part of making that possible.
